reviews.scope: entire exact-pinned one-file package, source static only

source.packaging_and_copyright: no content vendored; verify any third-party excerpt separately before redistribution

dimensions.name: procedural_clarity

dimensions.name: authority_and_safety
dimensions.rationale: One-time text artifact; no required tools, private reads or mutations

dimensions.name: failure_handling
dimensions.rationale: Missing-architecture and uncertain residual-risk stop conditions absent

dimensions.name: evidence_discipline
dimensions.rationale: Mitigated or accepted status lacks required evidence or sign-off

dimensions.name: dependency_coherence
dimensions.rationale: Complete one-file package, no required supporting references

dimensions.name: portability_honesty
dimensions.rationale: Technology-independent concept

dimensions.name: usefulness_and_differentiation

dimensions.name: effectiveness_design

concrete_findings: Critical: unpinned trufflesecurity/trufflehog@main contradicts its own action-pinning advice

May inspire a new independently governed pipeline with exact digest pins, scoped approval and validated gates

limitations: Full source inspection and exact Git tree check are not a SkillSpector scan, adversarial host acceptance, or a measured reviewer-effort improvement. No GitHub Actions, dependencies or third-party tooling executed.
